bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
umask 077
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,json,os
root=pathlib.Path('.ai-core');v=root/'distillation-venv';py=str(v/'bin/python')
assert v.is_dir() and not v.is_symlink()
p=subprocess.run([py,'-c','import torch;assert torch.__version__=="2.10.0+cpu" and not torch.cuda.is_available()'],capture_output=True,timeout=6)
assert p.returncode==0
cmd=[py,'-m','pip','--isolated','--disable-pip-version-check','install','--no-input','--only-binary=:all:','--index-url','https://pypi.org/simple','torch==2.10.0+cpu','transformers==5.24.1','peft==0.22.0']
with (root/'distillation-setup.log').open('ab') as log:
    try: rc=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=18).returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: rc=124
p=subprocess.run([py,'-c','import importlib.metadata as m,json; print(json.dumps({x:next((d.version for d in m.distributions() if d.metadata["Name"].lower()==x),None) for x in ("torch","transformers","peft","accelerate","safetensors","tokenizers")}))'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
report={'library_install_exit':rc,'installed':json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode==0 else {},'training_updates':0}
body='## Install Qwen3.5 Transformers and PEFT into verified CPU environment\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nCPU wheel pinned; no CUDA wheel or global package replacement.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5)
print(json.dumps(report))
